title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Caravan is definitely on for Jan 23-24. Seems to be some question about Tigerfest itself
Yeah, I’m trying to pin that down. Especially if it’s 100% not at Comerica
They’re protecting Paredes, Funkhouser, Burrows, Hill, Anthony Castro and Cameron, if you’re into that sort of thing

I think it’s still questionable. They are sensitive about the fact that we have no stars (Miggy unlikely to attend) so an autograph fest isn’t very appealing. They are leaning toward a smaller event maybe geared toward kids. Yes, I am...thank you. Is that what you expected? Headline tomorrow “Tigers protect 6 future stars in latest demonstration of sustained success”
Lol
I was kinda surprised by Hill, to be honest
Yea I have a feeling that’s one of those deals where someone isn’t ready to admit a mistake
Source: Dan Griesbaum leaving Tigers
Haha. I can verify. Was going to tell you soon but I just let them know. You have good sources who seem to care about shit that isn’t always that important lol
Lol
Congrats
Congrats is by far the most common response, and people don’t even know if I got fired or have another job or anything lol
I (think) I know what’s going on in there, I just gotta figure out how to formulate it into a story, hence the congrats

Yea I don’t know how you do it either. I think there is a lot of good info especially on the Wings side...I’m just not sure how much the typical reader would care about. One interesting place to start is asking about what Tom Wilson and Duane McLean do for a living. It’s basically nothing. Then that leads you to, ok, why are those people who did a heck of a job in that industry for decades just sitting on the sideline?  Then you say, where the heck is everyone named “Ilitch”, besides Chris? Well, they have enough money to live well and they want absolutely nothing to do with little brother so they are far away.  It would be a long story and it would be hard to get anyone to go on record with anything.
Good information. I’ve been working on a story about the culture change inside the org, but was saving you for later in the process, I don’t know why.

I haven’t ever really been given time to concentrate on it specifically. But yeah, give me a ring about it, I can meet up with you for a beer. I’m meeting with someone tomorrow night. I’ve talked to a lot of your co-workers
Sounds good. I’ll connect with you after I wrap things up. My last day with them is probably the day before Thanksgiving.

Side note...did you read the story about Jeff David from the Kings? Chris Granger has no feel whatsoever for hiring decent character people. He’s a smart nerd but no people skills or street smarts at all
Give me a call whenever you have a few mins tonight
Ok- should be able to around 8:30. Coaching for about an hour between now and then
K
